verdict: INCOMPLETE: physical Android acceptance NOT TESTED
scope: Established local Worker/disposable D1; actual desktop Chrome camera pipeline with synthetic video; no physical Android device

physicalAndroidChecks.scenario: PWA installation and cold offline startup
Physical camera, permissions and screen-to-screen normal/multipart pack scanning
Device reconnection, reboot/storage retention and authenticated billing sync

scenarios.scenario: PWA offline readiness and offline request creation
scenarios.evidence: **New P6-01/04:** actual online catalogue/device/QR preparation, two requests queued offline, cached shell verified, full Owner Chrome process restart and offline page reopening with all five mixed-request operation IDs/snapshots intact. Desktop scope; Android installation remains NOT TESTED below.

scenarios.scenario: Normal QR generation, scanning, preview, acceptance and handover
scenarios.evidence: **New desktop PASS, P6-01/02/05:** real signed v1 export, three QR frames, actual `getUserMedia` → video → canvas → `jsQR` decoding → full preview → explicit offline acceptance → later Worker handover. Repeated camera scan retains one operation; tracks stop after decoding. Camera input is synthetic desktop video, not a physical Android camera. Full physical screen-to-screen acceptance remains unperformed.

**New P6-01/03/05 + DB:** v2 mixed transfer with two separate fixed catalogue variants, complete ordered components and metadata, exact quantities/labels/prices, actual synthetic-camera preview and acceptance, unchanged saved snapshots through adjusted quotation, closure and payment. **Retained:** `logs/fix-handover.log` passing 80-component transfer/server-boundary tests.

scenarios.scenario: Owner offline adjustments, finalization and payment
scenarios.evidence: **New P6-04/05:** ordinary loose-unit override ₹9 and bill discount ₹10; queued ₹500 agreement, closure and ₹100 payment. Original pack prices unchanged. Adjusted quotation ₹1,617; final due ₹500; received ₹100; outstanding ₹400. **Retained:** Phase 4's full/partial/HOLD/method/permission matrix.

**New P6-05:** successful HANDOVER response dropped after commit; original HANDOVER retried, EDIT acknowledged, AGREEMENT then interrupted before dispatch. Same five IDs eventually acknowledge once. No second bill, claim, receipt or payment.

scenarios.scenario: Duplicate scans/acceptance, lost responses and duplicate operations
scenarios.evidence: **New P6-02/05 + DB:** same normal camera sequence scanned/accepted twice, one local HANDOVER; mixed lost-response replay returns original identity; six receipts for six acknowledged operations, one payment. **Retained P5-03/07:** simultaneous same-operation CREATE/payment/QR copies share one commit, plus duplicate local QR acceptance.

scenarios.scenario: Expired authentication, changed membership and invalid recipients
scenarios.evidence: **New P6-AUTH-TTL:** real newly inserted expired Owner session returns 401, fresh password session 200; server clock unchanged. **New P6-06:** invalid-session replay of the acknowledged mixed operation returns 401. Guards reject expired preparation and wrong recipient. **Retained P3-QR-01/02:** signature-valid wrong Owner rejected; sender removal and recipient demotion invalidate new reconciliation attempts (403); intended recipient succeeds.

scenarios.scenario: Tampering, incompatible catalogue versions and revision conflicts
scenarios.evidence: **New guards:** tampered composition, private-field injection, missing products/variants, version-only mismatch, changed composition/unit/price/variant and substitution explicitly rejected with no local draft/outbox commit. **Retained real Worker:** `Family Pack catalogue drift rejects handover and preserves original accepted snapshot`; P5-04/05 stale revisions preserve local/server versions and final bills.

scenarios.scenario: Competing QR claims and offline closures
scenarios.evidence: **Retained real Worker:** `competing offline QR claims preserve one server claim and detect the loser`, `competing closures cannot both commit`. **Retained P5-06:** separate Owner/Super Admin browser closures produce one winner and a preserved 409 conflict. **New DB:** exactly two claims, one per new normal/mixed transfer, without retry duplication. No new competitive race was executed merely to repeat Phase 5.

scenarios.scenario: Admin cannot access Owner-only purchase/profit information
scenarios.evidence: **New P6-01/03/06:** Admin private preparation is empty; Owner preparation positively contains two private rows. QR contains no purchase/profit/margin/final-price/device-secret/private-key data. Admin catalogue/request/quotation/history surfaces redact private values. Guards reject Admin acceptance and private snapshot field injection. **Retained:** P3/P4 role and financial-modification denials.

scenarios.scenario: QR handover independent from cloud synchronization
scenarios.evidence: **New P6-02/03/05:** offline QR acceptance produces only local draft/outbox; authoritative Worker lookup still returns 404 and no sync POST occurs. Only explicit online synchronization materializes each original request/claim. Sender retains its original CREATEs; later source sync becomes preserved conflicts against the same request IDs, not new bills.

scenarios.scenario: Unsupported Family Pack cases safely blocked
scenarios.evidence: **New P6-BLOCK/P6-GUARD cases:** unsupported options/nesting/empty definitions, invalid quantities/loose packs, over-limit payloads, missing historical snapshots, legacy partial drafts and offline pack price overrides rejected explicitly. Failed imports leave zero new drafts/outbox entries in isolated module tests. Unsupported capabilities remain NOT IMPLEMENTED, as detailed below. No feature was added.
